caption: The drawing depicts a single object—a tall, slender stand drawn in black lines on a light beige background. The stand consists of a vertical rod with a slightly irregular, twisted appearance. At the top, there is a curved, hook-like extension attached to the rod. The base of the stand branches out into three evenly spaced legs, each ending in a flattened, rounded foot that stabilizes the stand on the surface. The drawing is minimalistic, showing no other objects or background details, and the entire composition is centered on the page. The overall color scheme is monochromatic, with only the black linework and the neutral paper tone present.
